summary: Master bid management and proposal strategy with practical tools, pricing control, and proposal writing exercises. Learn to win more corporate sales bids.
lede: Bid management and proposal strategy gives corporate sales teams a repeatable way to qualify opportunities, understand buyer requirements, coordinate contributors, and govern the response. It brings structure to bid-or-no-bid decisions, compliance control, commercial positioning, pricing, and approval paths so teams can produce clear, persuasive submissions under pressure. This course develops practical capability through bid plans, win themes, message trees, pricing decision sheets, and executive summaries. You will also explore AI-assisted RFP summarization and digital collaboration workflows in Microsoft Teams or SharePoint, helping you build submission packages buyers can evaluate quickly and confidently.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who work directly on corporate bids, proposals, and sales pursuits and need a more disciplined way to manage responses, pricing, and approval workflows.
prerequisites: To get the most from the course, bring a laptop, a recent RFP or proposal example, and access to your usual collaboration tools such as Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, or a similar document workspace. A basic understanding of your organization’s sales process, approval flow, and pricing approach will help you complete the exercises faster.
